purpose: Shared, compact handoff state for parallel agents. This file is the source of truth for task ownership, latest outcomes, SHAs, blockers and next actions.

protocol.update_scope: Modify only the current agent's entry and shared metadata directly affected by its work. Preserve all other agents' entries.
protocol.history_policy: Append one concise update per completed task or material milestone. Keep only the newest 3 updates. Keep current_state and next_action accurate even when older updates are dropped.
protocol.sha_policy: Always record the exact branch and commit SHA actually inspected or changed. Never report CI, preview, tests or deployment as current if they belong to another SHA.
protocol.concurrency: Before writing, fetch the latest file from coordination/agents and use its current blob SHA. If update fails due to conflict/stale SHA, fetch again, merge only your own entry, and retry. Never overwrite another agent's update.
protocol.truthfulness: Separate verified facts, user-reported facts and assumptions. Unknown values must be null or explicitly marked unknown.
protocol.security: Never store secrets, tokens, passwords, recovery links, personal data or credential values. Record only secret names and rotation status if relevant.
safety: No production changes, external configuration changes, deploys, remote migrations or merges unless the user explicitly authorizes that exact action.
Do not expand task scope or modify another agent's ownership area without coordination.
protocol.handoff: A new agent must read this file first, inspect the live PR/branch state, then continue from current_state and next_action. Historical entries are context, not proof of current remote state.
